name: botlish
description: Botlish's language server (main.tcl -lsp) in VS Code: diagnostics, hover, go to definition, references.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a restricted workspace the workspace's own settings cannot choose the executables that start the language server.

botlish.tclsh.markdownDescription: The Tcl 9 interpreter that runs `main.tcl -lsp`. Empty: `tclsh9.0` or `tclsh90` on PATH, else (Windows) `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Apps\Tcl90\bin\tclsh90.exe` or `C:\botlish-tcl\bin\tclsh9.0.exe`.

botlish.main.markdownDescription: `main.tcl` of a Botlish checkout. Empty: the checkout this extension was loaded from, when it was (`editors/vscode` of a checkout); else the single executable `botlish` on PATH.

botlish.server.command.markdownDescription: The whole command that starts the server, for example `["botlish", "-lsp"]`. When set, `#botlish.tclsh#` and `#botlish.main#` are not used; `#botlish.target#` and `#botlish.warnings#` are still appended.

botlish.target.markdownDescription: The compilation target the server analyzes for (`-target`), for example `linux-x86_64`. Empty: the host's. A program importing `linux::*` is `UNSUPPORTED-PLATFORM` on another host's target.

botlish.warnings.description: The warning policy of the analysis (-warnings).

botlish.debounce.description: Milliseconds after the last change before the server analyzes again (initializationOptions.debounce).
